author: Karl Rock
description:
I went shopping in Karachi, Pakistan, with one mission: find a beautiful Balochi suit for my Indian wife, Manisha Malik.

Manisha is passionate about desi fashion, but there was one thing missing from her collection: a proper Balochi suit. She didn't want a cheap, machine-made outfit. She wanted something special, with beautiful embroidery and stitching that represented the traditional craftsmanship of Balochistan.

So I headed into some of Karachi's busiest traditional markets to see if I could find one.

Follow Manisha for her desi fashion content:

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/c/manishamalikindia
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/iammanishamalik

First stop was Zainab Market in Saddar, one of Karachi's best-known shopping markets. Zainab Market is a great place to visit if you're looking for affordable clothing, export-surplus garments, leather jackets and bags, traditional clothing, shawls, jewellery, handicrafts and other souvenirs.
